item.title: JKMAX Recalls Heated Blankets and Heating Pads Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
item.company: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from September 2022 through July 2026 as both a one-pack or a two-pack.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from September 2022 through July 2026 as both a one-pack or a two-pack.
item.product: JKMAX Heated Blankets and Heating Pads
item.summary: This recall involves all heating pads and heated blankets sold by JKMax including models JKMAX-002, JKMAX-7284B, JKMAX-6284B, JKMAX-10090B, JKMAX-8490B and JKMAX-6284B. The heated blankets and heating pads are blue, gray, brown or red. They are made of polyester fabric and are machine washable. The blankets and pads were sold in multiple sizes, and both have a detachable white remote that can be used to adjust the heat. The model number is located on the back of the remote and is also printed on a white label affixed to the product packaging along with the brand name “JKMAX”.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: JKMAX Heated Blankets and Heating Pads.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled blankets and pads immediately and contact JKMax for a full refund.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
